body: Triage note: {{Name}} / {{Email}} / {{custom:phone}} all appear before the first full stop, then the shipping clue {{custom:postal_code}}, login origin {{custom:ip_address}}, and refund IBAN {{custom:iban}} appear in the next clause. The paragraph deliberately stays short, repeats normal ticket language, and includes non-label values such as CASE-77 and 10:15 to keep density high without real data.
notes: High-density EN triage paragraph with six labels.
